summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of new PeriodPicker (selector de Mes/Año) across Ventas (finca/ciudad/donaciones), Cosecha, Aplicaciones, and RRHH→Nómina. All 4 modules behave correctly: picker hidden by default; clicking the 'Mes' pill reveals <input type=month> with current month pre-loaded; clicking the 'Año' pill reveals a <select> of years; switching pills mutually hides the other picker; clicking other pills (Todo/Todos/Hoy/Semana) hides both pickers. Filter reactivity verified on Cosecha (1 row → 0 rows when mes=2020-01 → 1 row back when mes=current).
critical_code_review_comments: Inconsistent pill testid naming across modules: Ventas/Cosecha use the Spanish character 'año' in testids (filtro-periodo-año, cosecha-periodo-año), while Aplicaciones/RRHH use ASCII 'ano' (aplic-periodo-ano, nomina-periodo-ano). For automated testing this is brittle. Suggest unifying to 'anio' across all modules (matches the picker testid suffix '-picker-anio').
Inconsistent 'all' pill testid: Ventas/Cosecha use '...periodo-todo'; Aplicaciones/RRHH use '...periodo-todos'. Suggest unifying.

Year <select> only shows years present in the dataset + the current year. When data only exists for 2026 (current), the user sees just one option, which makes the 'Año' picker feel inert. Consider populating with a small range (e.g. currentYear-5 .. currentYear+1) so users can pick a past/future year even with no data.
PeriodPicker.jsx: when isYear is true but `years` is empty (theoretical), the <select> would render with no options. Defensive default years={[currentYearStr()]} would be safer.
seed_data_creation: None. Existing data (1 cosecha registered for 2026-05) was used for filter reactivity check; no TEST_* records created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pill testids per module: Ventas -> filtro-periodo-{todo|hoy|semana|mes|año}; Cosecha -> cosecha-periodo-{todo|hoy|semana|mes|año}; Aplicaciones -> aplic-periodo-{todos|hoy|semana|mes|ano}; Nómina -> nomina-periodo-{todos|hoy|semana|mes|ano}. PeriodPicker testids: {prefix}-picker-mes (input type=month) and {prefix}-picker-anio (select). Routes used: /dashboard/ventas/{finca,ciudad,donaciones}, /dashboard/cosecha, /dashboard/aplicaciones, /dashboard/rrhh/nomina.
